disposition_reason: Per-sample ICP-SFMS concentrations of 20 elements including Cd, Hg and Pb are printed for 36 protein powders bought in Ireland in 2016-2017.

study.design: method validation plus market survey of protein powder supplements with risk assessment
study.market: purchased online and from local retail outlets in Cork, Ireland (14 brands)
study.method: ICP-SFMS (Thermo ELEMENT2) after microwave digestion of 0.5 g powder with HNO3/HCl
lod: Final LOQ-equivalent concentrations as printed: Li <17.4, Be <0.9, Sn <17.4, Cd <0.61, Hg <0.2, V <0.6, Bi <0.1 µg/kg; full LOD/LOQ in Supplementary Section S4 (not read)
study.qa: CRM Seronorm Trace Elements Urine L-2 recoveries 85-115%; matrix-spiked controls on sample P14 at five levels, recoveries mostly 87.8-123.2% (Table 2)
